allot.subject: Issue of Securities
allot.text: Rama Steel Tubes Limited has informed the Exchange about issue of Securities by way of Preferential Issue.

allot.subject: Preferential issue
allot.text: Rama Steel Tubes Limited has informed the Exchange about Withdrawal of proposed preferential issue of up to 15,34,50,146 equity shares.

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Rama Steel Tubes Limited has informed the Exchange about the Allotment of 7,77,77,778 equity shares on preferential basis.

allot.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
allot.text: Rama Steel Tubes Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of   Acquisition and Allotment Committee of the Board of Directors of the Company held on September 23, 2025.

allot.subject: Disclosure of material issue
allot.text: Rama Steel Tubes Limited has informed regarding Preferential Issue of Equity Shares.

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Rama Steel Tubes Limited has informed the Exchange about the Allotment of Equity Shares on a Preferential basis for consideration other than cash

allot.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
allot.text: Rama Steel Tubes Limited has informed the Exchange regarding  Board meeting held on April 29, 2025 for Allotment of Equity Shares on a Preferential basis.
